# T002: Login and logout endpoints

## Goal
When this task is done, a visitor can open `/login`, submit the form, receive the `sid` cookie and be redirected to `/`, and sign out again from any page.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a registered user, When `POST /api/login` is called with the right password, Then the response is 204 and sets an `HttpOnly` `sid` cookie.
- Given a wrong password or an unknown user, When `POST /api/login` is called, Then the response is 401 with body `{ "error": "invalid credentials" }`.
- Given a signed-in user, When `POST /api/logout` is called, Then the response is 204 and the session is removed from the store.

## Target files
- src/auth/routes.ts
- src/auth/session.ts
- src/auth/pages/login.html
- test/auth/routes.test.ts

## Contracts
- contracts/auth-api.md
- TokenCodec (spec.md §Contracts)

## Out of scope
- Protecting other routes (T004).
- Refreshing sessions (T003).

## Notes for the worker
Register the routes as a function `registerAuthRoutes(server, store, codec)`. Put the cookie read/write helpers in `src/auth/session.ts`.
